headline: Quiet Saturday; recent safety news slowly fades
body: No scored events today. Earlier announcements faded a little, easing Descendants and several others by a hundredth or two. Horizon Balance is -6.76, near its lowest of the month. Enslaved God leads at 42.52; Conquerors sits second at 30.42.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 to 0.02 each.
